candidate.user_submission: Pikin na 18 months old. E get cough or e dey breathe with wahala. E no get diarrhoea. E no get ear problem. E no get fever. Dem count e breath for one full minute. Dem check am when e calm. Dem count 35 breaths for one minute. E don dey cough for 3 days. E chest dey go inside. E no dey wheeze. E no dey get wheeze wey dey happen again and again. E no get stridor when e calm. Dem no use pulse oximeter for am. Dem no see say pikin dey convulse now. Dem no hear say e don convulse before. E no dey weak or dey like person wey dey unconscious. E fit drink or suck breast. E no dey vomit everything. E no dey exposed to HIV or get HIV.
